imageAttribution: "Ralpharia gorgoniae" by Dan Schofield (CC BY 4.0). http://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/ GBIF occurrence 6131127983.

Flattened disc with tentacles ending in forked projections. Shorter tentacles around rim. May be found in clusters.
imageAttribution: "Rhodactis osculifera" by Matteo Bellucci (CC BY 4.0). http://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/ GBIF occurrence 6147378951.

imageAttribution: "Rhopalaea abdominalis" by Dan Schofield (CC BY 4.0). http://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/ GBIF occurrence 6130795959.

imageAttribution: "Sanopus splendidus" by Justin Philbois (CC0 1.0). http://creativecommons.org/publicdomain/zero/1.0/ GBIF occurrence 5903724018.

aboutText: Azooxanthellate (Ref. 116012). Can be found in shallow waters (Ref. 122680). Found on rock overhangs (Ref. 88997). In Hong Kong, also found in marine caves (Ref. 120542).

aboutText: Long dark red to black body. Often a pale stripe along the side. Found on Long Spine Sea Urchins (p. 149).
imageAttribution: "Tuleariocaris neglecta" by Matteo Bellucci (CC BY 4.0). http://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/ GBIF occurrence 6479991540.

aboutText: Triangular cone-shaped thickened leaves on a short stalk. Often with dark brown speckles and pale centers.
Tall erect stalks covered in triangular leaves with distinct rounded swellings in the centers. Found in the shallows.
imageAttribution: "Turbinaria turbinata" by Andrew Bleiman (CC0 1.0). http://creativecommons.org/publicdomain/zero/1.0/ GBIF occurrence 5087186349.

aboutText: Robust shell with a long tapering aperture lip. Mantle is mottled black and orange and is commonly buried.
imageAttribution: "Turbinella angulata" by Jean-Paul Boerekamps (CC0 1.0). http://creativecommons.org/publicdomain/zero/1.0/ GBIF occurrence 5063958032.

aboutText: Orange to brown shell with ridges and a long curving aperture lip. Pale mantle with dark reddish blotches.
imageAttribution: "Turritriton labiosus" by Josiah Londerée (CC BY 4.0). http://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/ GBIF occurrence 6399762741.

aboutText: Robust light to dark gray body with a paler abdomen. Short rostrum. Coastal individuals are usually smaller.
imageAttribution: "Tursiops truncatus" by Dan Horowitz (CC0 1.0). http://creativecommons.org/publicdomain/zero/1.0/ GBIF occurrence 5938229303.

aboutText: Bluish-green upper body, silvery below. Dark lateral keel at tail base. Lower tail lobe is longer than upper lobe.
imageAttribution: "Tylosurus crocodilus" by Светлана Царахова (CC0 1.0). http://creativecommons.org/publicdomain/zero/1.0/ GBIF occurrence 6162811603.

aboutText: Calcified green blade with a felt-like texture, as wide as it is tall. Narrow stalk. Often found in deeper sandy areas.
imageAttribution: Caribbean Reef Life (Mickey Charteris, 4th ed.)

aboutText: Thin ragged-edged cup of light green, attached by a thin stalk. Often found in sandy areas in large groupings.
Narrow fan shape extending out from a single stalk. Thick-walled. Dark green with pale edges on the blade.
imageAttribution: "Udotea flabellum" by natalie (CC0 1.0). http://creativecommons.org/publicdomain/zero/1.0/ GBIF occurrence 3860328404.

aboutText: Broad fan-shaped green blades on a single short stalk. Distinctive lines radiate to the edge of the blades.
Slender silvery body (may show faint bars). Concave below lower jaw. Large eye with dark spot above iris.
imageAttribution: "Ulaema lefroyi" by Jacob Weston (CC BY 4.0). http://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/ GBIF occurrence 5166778022.

aboutText: Pale central disc with a brown circle inside. Short brown tentacles. Found encrusting vase and rope sponges.
imageAttribution: "Umimayanthus parasiticus" by Jean-Paul Boerekamps (CC0 1.0). http://creativecommons.org/publicdomain/zero/1.0/ GBIF occurrence 5064064757.

aboutText: Rounded silvery to dusky body, sometimes with faint bars. Low triangular dorsal fin and tail, often darker gray.
imageAttribution: Photo via WoRMS Photogallery — cottonmouth jack (Uraspis secunda); author WoRMS contributor; AphiaID 159658, pic 2548

aboutText: Variable yellow to brown body with dark blotches and small yellow spots. Snout and tips of fins are rounded.
imageAttribution: "Urobatis jamaicensis" by Stari Plativky (CC0 1.0). http://creativecommons.org/publicdomain/zero/1.0/ GBIF occurrence 6188071947.

aboutText: Transparent body with a rounded hump towards a long transparent tail. A second set of claws behind the first.
imageAttribution: Caribbean Reef Life (Mickey Charteris, 4th ed.)

aboutText: Clear bell, taller than it is wide. Four distinct orange radial canals. Up to 100 short bright orange tentacles.
imageAttribution: Photo via WoRMS Photogallery — Hitchhiking Jelly (Vallentinia gabriellae); author collected and photographed by Allen Collins; AphiaID 291273, pic 185597

aboutText: Flat body with pale contractile tentacles from either end. Color matches substrate, with pink or brown highlights.
imageAttribution: "Vallicula multiformis" by Sinaloa Silvestre (CC0 1.0). http://creativecommons.org/publicdomain/zero/1.0/ GBIF occurrence 6129966084.

aboutText: A spreading mat of pale to olive-green rounded or oval bubble shapes. Distinctive silvery sheen on the surface.
imageAttribution: "Valonia macrophysa" by Thomas Irvine (CC BY 4.0). http://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/ GBIF occurrence 3985879577.

aboutText: Clumps of dark green elongated bubbles, randomly branching with bulbous tips. Found in sheltered areas.
imageAttribution: "Valonia utricularis" by Borja Fierro (CC BY 4.0). http://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/ GBIF occurrence 6235780312.

aboutText: Large rounded dark to olive-green bubbles, often with a silvery sheen. May grow individually or in small clusters.
imageAttribution: "Valonia ventricosa" by Daniel Estabrooks (CC0 1.0). http://creativecommons.org/publicdomain/zero/1.0/ GBIF occurrence 6400540395.

aboutText: Dense clusters of shiny dark green filaments, growing to form a dense cushion. Found in calm shallow areas.
imageAttribution: "Valoniopsis pachynema (G.Martens) Børgesen" by Meise Botanic Garden (CC BY 4.0). http://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/ GBIF occurrence 4072829281.

aboutText: Thick-walled shell with a small pointed conical spire. Mantle is brown and speckled. Often covered in algae.
imageAttribution: Caribbean Reef Life (Mickey Charteris, 4th ed.)
"Verongula gigantea" by Tommy (CC0 1.0). http://creativecommons.org/publicdomain/zero/1.0/ GBIF occurrence 6179517301.

aboutText: Maximum depth reported taken from Ref. 128739. Common on open reef habitats more than 3 m deep (Ref. 415), and in mangroves (Ref. 86836). Inhabits heavily silted lower mesophotic reefs (Ref. 128739).
imageAttribution: "Verongula rigida" by Matteo Bellucci (CC BY 4.0). http://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/ GBIF occurrence 6159260125.

aboutText: Elongated ribbed white shell with thin dark bands above each whorl. Often a broader dark band on the final whorl.
Highly ridged dark red shell with yellow and black bands. Black mantle and proboscis. White-banded tentacles.
imageAttribution: Caribbean Reef Life (Mickey Charteris, 4th ed.)

aboutText: Bright orange shell with a sharply pointed spire. Bands of small black markings. Single white band on final whorl.
Rounded shell with bulbous spire. Wavy zigzag lines and spots. Dominant color may be black, green or reddish.
imageAttribution: "Vitta virginea" by Lucas Rodrigues (CC0 1.0). http://creativecommons.org/publicdomain/zero/1.0/ GBIF occurrence 6188267096.

aboutText: Pale brown thick-walled shell circled with distinctive thin brown lines. White mantle with brown and gold markings.
imageAttribution: "Voluta musica" by Emily K (CC BY 4.0). http://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/ GBIF occurrence 5104356097.

aboutText: Pale oblong shell with three broad brown bands (may be diffuse). Orange spots on white mantle and proboscis.
imageAttribution: "Volvarina albolineata" by Thomas Irvine (CC BY 4.0). http://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/ GBIF occurrence 4075613811.

aboutText: Pale oblong shell with dark mottling. Knobby texture on white-spotted mantle. Dark banding on pale tentacles.
Elongated orange shell with pale stripes. Mantle and proboscis solid orange or pale with dark orange spots.
imageAttribution: Caribbean Reef Life (Mickey Charteris, 4th ed.)

aboutText: Orange-yellow with a thin yellow stripe. Thin blue line on head. Rare, found among deep Masked/Glass Gobies.
Flattened gray to pinkish carapace with highly variable markings. Numerous blunt spines protruding from sides.
Tall bushy pink alga with long thin central branches. Smaller light pink branchlets grow out in a single plane.
imageAttribution: "Wrangelia penicillata" by Paul Braun (CC0 1.0). http://creativecommons.org/publicdomain/zero/1.0/ GBIF occurrence 5844206024.

aboutText: Tangled masses of fine hair-like deep red filaments, each repeatedly branching outwards. May cover large areas.
imageAttribution: Caribbean Reef Life (Mickey Charteris, 4th ed.)

aboutText: Purple body with rows of small black spots. Three dark lines on cheek. White patch above eye. Tail edged in red.
distinctiveFeatures: Body shape: short and / or deep
imageAttribution: "Xanthichthys ringens" by Justin Philbois (CC0 1.0). http://creativecommons.org/publicdomain/zero/1.0/ GBIF occurrence 5903722079.

aboutText: Flat-bottomed conical shell, typically with other shells and pieces of coral debris cemented on for protection.
imageAttribution: "Xenophora conchyliophora" by Reanne ("Bean") Dunn (CC BY 4.0). http://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/ GBIF occurrence 5063512492.

aboutText: Maximum depth reported taken from Ref. 128739.. Maximum length refers to base diameter (Ref. 99323). Common on reef environments (Ref. 415). Also found in mangroves (Ref. 86836). Inhabits shallow coral reefs, coral communities, coralline algae reefs, algal nodules, and mesophotic reefs (Ref. 128739).
imageAttribution: "Xestospongia muta" by Bonnie Isaac (CC0 1.0). http://creativecommons.org/publicdomain/zero/1.0/ GBIF occurrence 6185819962.

aboutText: Yellow cheek and gill cover with thin blue bars. Vertical blue lines on scales. Darkened pectoral base. Red iris.
imageAttribution: "Xyrichtys martinicensis" by Matteo Bellucci (CC BY 4.0). http://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/ GBIF occurrence 6185810803.

aboutText: The largest of the razorfishes. Blue lines under a small eye. Blunt forehead. Often a single diffuse body bar.
imageAttribution: "Xyrichtys novacula" by Karim Haddad (CC BY 4.0). http://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/ GBIF occurrence 6179538305.

aboutText: Pink to reddish with dark edges on scales. Pale blue bars on lower head. Often a blue spot on dorsal fin. Red iris.
imageAttribution: "Xyrichtys splendens" by Justin Philbois (CC0 1.0). http://creativecommons.org/publicdomain/zero/1.0/ GBIF occurrence 5908879798.

aboutText: Bushy, with slightly flattened red branches. Branchlets are short with darker tips. Prefers areas of strong surge.
imageAttribution: Caribbean Reef Life (Mickey Charteris, 4th ed.)

aboutText: Small elongated bell with a pointed tip. Four long trailing tentacles with distinctive rows of small white bulbs.
imageAttribution: Photo via WoRMS Photogallery — Zancleopsis jelly (Zancleopsis dichotoma); author FLMNH IZ Collection # UFID 13818; AphiaID 288110, pic 150004

aboutText: Color and density are highly variable, in loose patches of individuals or in clusters. May show bright fluorescence.
imageAttribution: "Zoanthus pulchellus" by Pauline Walsh Jacobson (CC BY 4.0). http://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/ GBIF occurrence 4129905486.
